steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2022, a guest on Equity Mates explained Adbri runs Sunstate in Queensland as a joint venture with Boral, highlighting Boral’s role in cement and concrete through that partnership.

episode.title: Cement's sustainability challenge - Theresa Mlikota, CFO of Adbri | ASX CEO Connect Series

views.text: In September 2021, Equity Mates noted Boral makes building materials like concrete and cement, and said it had just launched a sustainability strategy about “building a better future” in a carbon‑intensive sector.

episode.title: CEO: Zlatko Todorcevski - Turning Boral Around Amidst Seven Group's Takeover | Boral (ASX: BLD)

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In April 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Boral’s earnings had exceeded many expectations after the Seven Group deal, pointing to better-than-anticipated operating performance.

episode.title: Expert: Joe Wright - Three ways to invest in resources | Airlie Funds Management

views.text: In September 2021, Equity Mates recapped that Boral had six profit downgrades in two years and said the incoming CEO believed the company had strong assets but underperformed, beginning a listening tour to drive a turnaround.

episode.title: CEO: Zlatko Todorcevski - Turning Boral Around Amidst Seven Group's Takeover | Boral (ASX: BLD)
